bullets.text: Mobile Boost for UK Economy - Improved connectivity could create 49,000 businesses and add £6.6bn annually, says **VodafoneThree**.
TalkTalk Business Independence - **TalkTalk Business** completes separation from parent, enhancing its autonomy and growth potential.
O2 Satellite Service Launched - **Virgin Media O2** introduces satellite-to-mobile service, boosting coverage to 95% across the UK.
Data Sovereignty in Cloud Calling - **BT** unveils Sovereign Voice to ensure compliance with local regulations for cloud communications.
6G Strategy Unveiled by ZTE - **ZTE** outlines its vision for 6G, focusing on AI integration and space-air-ground network convergence.
Agentic AI in Network Optimization - New AI solutions are enhancing network performance and reliability in challenging environments.
Orange and Samsung Expand Open RAN - **Orange** and **Samsung** enhance their partnership to grow Open RAN deployments in Europe.
5G Standalone Transformation Ahead - **Ericsson** highlights the imminent benefits of 5G SA for UK mobile networks and customer experience.
